fb.caption:
Pain feeling extra loud today? Space weather is stormy from a very fast solar wind and a south-tilted field, which can press on sensitive systems—some people may notice sharper edges to pain and energy that shows up in short, clearer bursts, often later rather than steadily all day. Expect some up-and-down instead of a smooth glide.

Try structuring your day like intervals: do one thing with full attention, then pause on purpose before starting the next. That small reset can keep your nervous system from stacking strain and makes room for steadier focus when it does arrive. Keep sips of water going and don’t skip meals to avoid crashy dips. Choose light movement over pushy workouts, and dim bright lights or quiet extra noise if your body feels prickly. What would make your next pause actually restful today?
